1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Februari 2019.

Jenis biobahan api yang diadunkan dengan apa-apa bahan api lain, peratusan

adunan dan penggunaan mandatori

2. (1) Jenis biobahan api yang diadunkan dengan apa-apa bahan api lain dalam

ruang (1) Jadual hendaklah jenis biobahan api dalam ruang (2), peratusan adunan

biobahan api itu dalam ruang (3) dan jenis bahan api yang diadunkan dengan biobahan

api itu dalam ruang (4).

(2) Penggunaan jenis biobahan api yang diadunkan dengan apa-apa bahan api

lain dalam ruang (1) hendaklah mandatori bagi aktiviti yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (5).

Pembatalan

3. Peraturan-Peraturan Industri Biobahan Api Malaysia (Peratusan Adunan dan

Penggunaan Mandatori) 2014 [P.U. (A) 320/2014] dibatalkan.

MALAYSIAN BIOFUEL INDUSTRY ACT 2007

MALAYSIAN BIOFUEL INDUSTRY (BLENDING PERCENTAGE AND MANDATORY USE)

REGULATIONS 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 4(a) and (b) of the

Malaysian Biofuel Industry Act 2007 [Act 666], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Malaysian Biofuel Industry

(Blending Percentage and Mandatory Use) Regulations 2019.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 February 2019.

Type of biofuel blended with any other fuel, blending percentage and

mandatory use

2. (1) The type of biofuel blended with any other fuel in column (1) of the

Schedule shall be type of fuel in column (2), percentage of the blended biofuel in

column (3) and type of fuel blended with the biofuel in column (4).

(2) The use of type of biofuel blended with any other fuel in column (1) shall

be mandatory for the activities specified in column (5).

Revocation

3. The Malaysian Biofuel Industry (Blending Percentage and Mandatory Use)

Regulations 2014 [P.U. (A) 320/2014] are revoked.
